Download **LivePlus-Ledger.apk** from the release assets. Requires Android 8.0 or newer. **SHA256SUMS.txt** contains the APK checksum.

See **docs/INSTALLATION.md** for installation, Play Protect prompts and notification-access setup.

Track accelerated spending and estimated cashback, review transaction categories, link refunds and export backups. Cashback estimates depend on merchant classification and posting dates; reconcile them with your card statement.

Export a backup before uninstalling or changing phones.
